conditions.private-entry: Only a ClusterIP listener, authenticated with a high-entropy API key; no public Service or DNS entry.
conditions.fixed-model: Only gec-small routes to the one identity-verified WriterAssist pool. No provider fallbacks, arbitrary backends, JWT/JWKS, custom plugins or model-supplied code.
conditions.private-ca: The EPP x509 High finding remains. Its TLS peers are the fixed private Kubernetes API and gateway services, without attacker-supplied intermediate certificates. Model metric scraping is private HTTP.
conditions.resource-isolation: Proxy replicas are spread across protected CPU hosts, the EPP is CPU-affined and bounded, and Cilium restricts API/model/metric flows. Admission permits private host/remote-node identities on port 9443 for the self-managed API servers. Endpoint-picker selectors use the pinned chart Pod label. The fixed gateway may reach controller xDS on 18000/18002. Scrape monitors use separate named, port-scoped policies.

limitations: One EPP and one A10 model; no serving HA claim. One EPP High finding is retained. Public exposure needs a separate review.
